scientific_integrity: The rank-two matroid halfspace description, beta and Dirichlet formulas, and classical Stirling asymptotics are credited. The asserted result is the strict continuous-volume covariance spectrum and its sharp exponential relative gap, not Ehrhart positivity, face enumeration, or a new probability law.
scientific_limitations: Proved for fixed integer number r >= 3 of equal parallel classes, with m >= 2. For the asymptotic, r is fixed and m tends to infinity; no unequal-class or growing-r classification is asserted. Potential equivalence with truncated Dirichlet formulas remains a literature risk. No independent mathematical validation has occurred.
title: Exponential isotropization and a strict inertia split in balanced rank-two matroid polytopes
